quote_repairs.route_label: pretraining cpg0000 full-field fluorescence images to single-cell instances
quote_repairs.original_quote: For cpg0000, full-field images were segmented into single-cell instances using Cellpose
quote_repairs.replacement_quote: We  curated  six  publicly  available  microscopy  datasets  for  multimodal  pretraining, including  LIVECell,  cpg0000,  PBC,  HPA,  HepG2,  and  B_ALL.  Among  them, LIVECell and cpg0000 consist of full-field microscopy images, whereas the remaining datasets provide single-cell images. For LIVECell, we directly used the cell instances provided with the original dataset. For cpg0000, full-field images were segmented into single-cell  instances  using  the  Cellpose  [1]  framework,  with  the  Hoechst  channel serving as the nuclear reference. When segmented cell images did not conform to a square shape, zero-padding was applied to obtain square inputs. For LIVECell, cpg0000, and HPA, the original pretraining and evaluation splits provided by the datasets were preserved, ensuring no overlap between the two subsets. Detailed descriptions of each dataset,  along  with  a  comprehensive  summary  of  the  pretraining  data  statistics,  are provided in Table S1.
